projects.title: I Can Fix It !
projects.description:
During this Hackathon 7 at ITESM we develop a Windows 8 phone application that connected to a database and retrieved information to it. 
This app was meant to be a social network among students where they could report a bicycle if it was damaged, verify a fixed bicycle (with a photograph to prove it) and fix a bicycle then upload a photograph so that another person can verify that it was fixed. Whilst doing any of the above functions, people gained points and those that were on the top score weekly gained incentives. 

This app was meant to be used at ITESM because we (students) were granted with 100 bicycles for free use, but some of them started to get damaged and nobody fixed them. 

The app was developed with C# completely.

projects.title: Efficient Patrolling
projects.description:
OpenDataMty Civic Hackathon.
Application developed in C++ and C# to aid in the police patrol distribution for the San Nicolás Police Department. Our project won the third place.
My part in this proyect was creating the visual interface with C# that read the data sent to us by C++ in order to complete the proyect.
